Corollary
[Local bilinearity near nonconjugate laminations] 1. 9.7.5\group thurston.ch09.realizationsSource: thurston:page-0286 If $\gamma ,\gamma '\in \mathcal{ML}_0(S)$ are not topologically conjugate and at least one is essentially complete, then there are neighborhoods $U$ of $\gamma $ and $U'$ of $\gamma '$, each equipped with linear coordinates, for which intersection number restricts to a bilinear function on $U\times U'$.
